resources.string: What would you like to remember?
Picture the last time your day changed unexpectedly. Perhaps a meeting ran late or someone invited you to dinner. What would you want to remember about that day when you look back at your history?
Try finishing this sentence in your own words: “My plans changed when …” A few words about the day can tell you more than the timer alone.
The full guided program is in preparation. This reflection is free to read.
